Comment by al...@bedatadriven.com:

Score: Positive

General Comment:
Neat!
Just keep in mind that one of renjin's goal is to be able to run even in
restricted java environments (like appengine), where management beans might
not be available, so it's very possible that
ManagementFacotry.getRuntimeMXBean() will throw a SecurityException or
something else nasty, so we should catch this and probably not throw an
error.

If we're not going to throw an EvalException, though, I think we will have
to honor the function's contract:

Value:
An integer, usually an integer between 1 and 32767 under
Unix-alikes and a small positive integer under Windows.

So maybe return 1 instead of zero. I can imagine how a R package would get
tripped up by Sys.getpid() evaluating essentially FALSE.

Great work!

For more information:
http://code.google.com/p/renjin/source/detail?r=322
